headline: Prime Focus Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Prime Focus Limited has informed the Exchange about Closure of Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process ("CIRP") and discharge of the Interim Resolution Professional ("IRP") pursuant to the oral pronouncement of the…
detail: General Updates - Prime Focus Limited has informed the Exchange about Closure of Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process ("CIRP") and discharge of the Interim Resolution Professional ("IRP") pursuant to the oral pronouncement of the Hon'ble NCLAT dated July 10, 2026, in Comp. App. (AT) (Ins.) No. 850 of 2026
